round2.note: Round 4 (critic) fixes, each with its rows: (1) whole-shape draft is MAPPED (rows "draft whole-shape ...", one solid.draft call with every pull-square face; refusals for cone / sphere / ring / history / hollow / steep); (2) closed hollow is BUILT for box, cylinder and prism by outer minus inner (rows "closed hollow ..."; sphere refused because the engine cannot cut concentric spheres); (3) the cylinder / sphere whole-draft advice "draft the side faces one at a time" is gone (it cannot work: a cylinder has no right face); (4) sentences reworded: the draft cap ("square to the pull direction (z, set by from:'left')" and the from: words on OTHER axes), faces that were tilted or do not exist, hollow twice ("already hollow"), a bevel is no longer called a round, the chamfered-cylinder fallback no longer says "try a thinner wall"; (5) hollow-then-draft is measured at and around the wall thickness (hd2-* cases, 36 + 10 + 5 + 1) and split into a supported row (tilt inside the wall) and a refused row (tilt cuts through the wall); (6) hollow after a whole-shape BEVEL has rows (box refused: convention 4 c^3/6 of the base solid; cylinder refused: no independent formula); (7) whole-shape draft of a hollowed part is refused, with the raw engine's negative volume reproduced (shell-draft-r2-probe.txt); (8) hollow of a mirror or join whose result is a plain block is supported (it was an over-refusal), with a swallowed-face refusal.
round2.foundByFuzz: The whole-draft mapping first used the named sketch frame normal n for an extrude; the named xz plane has n = +Y but sweeps along -Y, so on a FRONT-plane extrude the face points fell off the part and the engine returned a silent wrong solid (9775.58 vs 8338.56). Fixed with u x v in wholeFaces, wordTie and critCoords. A second seeded fuzz generated U outlines whose arms overlapped (an invalid sketch); the engine built garbage from them with ok:true (17 to 34 percent off), so the whole draft now refuses an outline that touches or crosses itself (G-OUTLINE).

policy.G-CONVEX: The refusals of a hollow with inside corners (cut, slot, join, boss, pillar, L outline, mirror that is not a block, pocket, blind hole, ring) are POLICY, not engine incapacity. truck builds them and its volume equals the SHARP (mitre) closed form hollow-mitre-L40x15 truck 6402 vs sharp 6402 (0.0e+0); hollow-mitre-L40x10 truck - vs sharp 2104 (NaN); hollow-mitre-T truck 5232 vs sharp 5232 (0.0e+0); OCCT and brep-rs round the corner instead, so the two conventions differ by (1 - pi/4) w^2 (h - w) per reflex corner. A critic measured truck = OCCT with the intersection join on L, boss and slot cases to 1e-16; that is the same finding. The contract keeps them refused because the default rounding convention of the oracles would show a wall thicker than asked.

guards.G-CLOSED: closed hollow (no open face): built only for a plain box, cylinder, sphere or prism (history: nothing but non-copy moves). Outer solid minus an inner copy of the same primitive; after the build the volume must equal outer minus the exact inner volume (planar 1e-9, curved 5e-4) and the faces must at least double. Anything else is refused with a sentence that names what the part is made from or changed by.
guards.G-VOID: after a closed hollow only a move or a turn (checked: volume and face count unchanged) is accepted; every other feature that reads the sealed solid is refused.
guards.G-WHOLE-HOLLOW / G-WHOLE-HISTORY / G-WHO: whole-shape draft: refused when the target has been hollowed, joined, drilled, rounded, mirrored or drafted, when the root is not a box / prism / wedge / cylinder / polygon extrude, when a face is neither square nor parallel to the pull, when the outline is not simple, and for a cone or a sphere. Planar results use the quadratic-fit check (G-SWEEP), cylinders the exact frustum volume.
guards.G-CHAMFER: a box whose edges are all bevelled in one operation (ModelDoc roundStyle chamfer) is refused with the fillet-chamfer contract sentence, and a hollow of a bevelled cylinder with its own sentence.
guards.G-CONVEX: hollow refuses any target with an inside (reflex) edge or a cavity: join, cut, slot, boss, pillar, notch, L outline, pocket, groove, blind hole, mirror, repeat, hollow twice, ring. Through-holes are allowed. truck mitres the offset at a reflex edge; OCCT rounds it. Notch box: truck 8932, OCCT and closed form 8901.0973.
guards.G-PICK: a face point is the brep-rs primitive-frame point shifted by every move in the history, and checked against the current bounding box; a separate rotate/copy in the history is refused. Unguarded, a hollow after move opens the opposite face silently.
guards.G-TIE: a face word that names two faces equally (even prisms, odd prism right, wedge right/back) is refused; the kernels may break the tie differently (unguarded truck opens another face than OCCT on 6 of 21 hollow ties and 6 of 21 draft ties).
guards.G-THICK: wall >= min(open depth, half narrowest side) refused on boxes (exact), and for every shape a hollow must add faces and (planar) lose volume. Unguarded truck returns the full unhollowed solid.
guards.G-VANISH: a draft must keep its face count; a clipped wedge (face crossed) is refused. On its own it does NOT stop a wrong draft of a non-convex part (the face count stays the same): see G-SWEEP and G-REACH.
guards.G-SWEEP: a draft that fits changes the volume by exactly tan(angle) x M, so the same draft is re-run at a tiny angle on the same part to measure M and the result must lie on that line (planar 1e-9, curved 2e-5). Measured on the L extrude: good drafts sit on the line to 4e-12, every wrong one is off by 1.5e-2 or more. Catches a tilted face that is clipped by an arm, wall, notch or hole (L extrude left 60: 15267.9 returned; front 60: the undrafted 16500 returned, the draft silently dropped; multi-face drafts go negative).
guards.G-REACH: the volume line cannot see a tilted face that runs past the END of an inside wall into material behind it (joined L, back face 70 degrees: the sweep 27.5 passes the 20-long arm, volume stays on the line at 9252.52, OCCT says would not fit). For every part that is not a plain convex solid the inward sweep, tan(angle) x the height above or below the neutral plane, must stay shorter than the distance to the nearest other plane coordinate of the part along the face axis (box walls, sketch vertices, hole tangent planes, cutter walls of the history); two opposite drafted faces must not meet; a part whose geometry cannot be enumerated is refused with the same kind of sentence. Outward tilts are exempt. Conservative: it may refuse a draft that would have fit when the nearest coordinate belongs to a feature outside the face lateral extent.
guards.G-BLIND: hollow of a part with a blind hole is refused with its own sentence. It also protects against an engine HANG (see notes.hazards.HANG).
guards.G-ANGLE: draft angle magnitude over 89 refused with the real range.
guards.G-FROM: draft {from:word} is checked against the current bounding box; the script layer reads the ROOT primitive and falls back to 0 for prism, wedge, extrude, join.
guards.G-CAP / G-TWICE / G-FLAT / G-ROUND / G-R: face parallel to the pull; same face drafted twice; word naming a face the shape lacks; whole-shape round as big as the wall; a round on an edge of the open face as big as the wall (knife-edge rim). A bevel is allowed there.

hazards.HANG: TIME / HANG. SolidCraft solid.shell (hollow open top, wall 2) on a 40x30x20 box with a blind d8 hole whose floor is within about one wall of the outer bottom does not return in a usable time: it grinds for tens of seconds to minutes of CPU and then refuses with raw engine text (boolean Cut ... no result), and under machine load a 110 to 150 s window sees NO result and NO refusal at all (that is the 'hang' a critic measured). Measured (shell-draft-hang.mjs, one process per probe, killed at the limit): depth 17.9 hole at [8,5] (floor 2.1 above the outer bottom) built 8502.7614 faces 16 [cpu 3.5 s] (3.0 s wall) | depth 18 hole at [8,5] (floor 2.0 above the outer bottom) refused "boolean Cut: the operation failed: no result; the operation failed: coincident faces were " [cpu 39.4 s] (39.7 s wall) | depth 18.5 hole at [8,5] (floor 1.5 above the outer bottom) refused "boolean Cut: the operation failed: no result; the operation failed: not supported yet: the" [cpu 127.0 s] (127.2 s wall) | depth 19 hole at [8,5] (floor 1.0 above the outer bottom) refused "boolean Cut: the operation failed: no result; the operation failed: not supported yet: the" [cpu 78.7 s] (78.5 s wall) | depth 17.9 hole at [0,0] (floor 2.1 above the outer bottom) built 8502.7614 faces 16 [cpu 3.5 s] (3.3 s wall) | depth 18 hole at [0,0] (floor 2.0 above the outer bottom) refused "boolean Cut: the operation failed: no result; the operation failed: coincident faces were " [cpu 41.1 s] (41.8 s wall) | depth 18.5 hole at [0,0] (floor 1.5 above the outer bottom) refused "boolean Cut: the operation failed: no result; the operation failed: not supported yet: the" [cpu 145.8 s] (148.1 s wall) | depth 19 hole at [0,0] (floor 1.0 above the outer bottom) refused "boolean Cut: the operation failed: no result; the operation failed: not supported yet: the" [cpu 123.5 s] (125.5 s wall). It is reachable from the page only through hollow-after-blind-hole, which G-BLIND refuses before the engine is called. A watchdog / time budget is NOT part of this contract and cannot be assumed: any page that runs the engine must run it in a worker it can terminate, because the same engine can be slow on inputs this group did not enumerate (see also the extrude-pocket and blend-loft hang notes).
hazards.SLIT: hollow with a wall of exactly half the lateral side (15 on a 30 side) or the whole depth returns the FULL block (24000, 8 faces) with ok:true and no sentence: a zero-width slit. Caught by G-THICK (pre-check on boxes, post-check on every shape: a hollow must lose volume and gain faces).
hazards.DRAFT_ON_NONCONVEX: draft of a face on a part that is not convex returns a wrong volume with ok:true, the same face count and no sentence once the tilted face meets an inside wall, an arm, a notch, a hole or a pocket: L extrude (arm 15, height 20, neutral 0) left 60 degrees returns 15267.9 where the face has long since consumed the arm (sections closed form: refuse), front 60 returns the undrafted 16500, multi-face drafts return negative volumes (see the d-seq rows for the measured numbers). Caught by G-SWEEP (volume off the wedge line) and G-REACH (sweep past a wall). OCCT refuses these with "would not fit".

conventions.MITRE: truck mitres the hollow wall sharply at an inside (reflex) edge; OCCT and brep-rs round it with an arc of the wall radius. Per reflex corner the solid is thicker by (1 - pi/4) w^2 (h - w): hollow-mitre-L40x15: truck 6402 (sharp closed form 6402) vs OCCT 6386.5487 (rounded closed form 6386.5487), planar difference 2.4e-3; hollow-mitre-L40x10: truck - (sharp closed form 2104) vs OCCT 2102.0686 (rounded closed form 2102.0686), planar difference NaN; hollow-mitre-T: truck 5232 (sharp closed form 5232) vs OCCT 5201.0973 (rounded closed form 5201.0973), planar difference 5.9e-3. It is a convention difference, not a bug in either engine, but a student would see a wall thicker than asked, so every hollow with an inside edge is refused (G-CONVEX).

scriptLayerDefects: draft {from} (primitiveExtreme, reshape-script.ts) reads the root primitive: box/cylinder/sphere/cone/torus use their own centre, every other root gets 0, and later move/turn/join are ignored. Prism at the origin from:bottom gives neutral 0 instead of -10: closed form 11417.0924, OCCT 11688.3968, unguarded truck 11688.3968 (OCCT and truck consistently wrong; brep-rs refuses prism drafts).
oracleDefects: OCCT sequential draft: dbox-two-n-3 OCCT 14022.049 vs closed form 14022.049; dbox-four-n-3 OCCT REFUSES ("would not fit", a stale face handle after the first draft) vs closed form 13535.7497; dbox-four-n0 OCCT REFUSES ("would not fit", a stale face handle after the first draft) vs closed form 13966.7726; dbox-four-n3 OCCT REFUSES ("would not fit", a stale face handle after the first draft) vs closed form 14404.4089. Drafting the faces of a box one after another is exact in SolidCraft (the reference is the half-space closed form) but OCCT cannot be used as the oracle for it.

OCCT and brep-rs DROP the pocket when a draft follows it: dnc-pocket-right-in5 (pocket x 30..38, y 10..20, z 5..10, then draft right 5 degrees): OCCT 11868.767 and brep-rs 11868.767 are the DRAFTED PLATE WITHOUT THE POCKET; SolidCraft 11468.767 equals the sections closed form 11468.767 (the plate with the pocket). The draft feature targets the extrude, not the pocketed solid.
OCCT drafted(): neutral plane is gp_Pnt(0,0,neutral) for any pull axis, so from:front|back|left|right is wrong in OCCT (packages/script/src/topo-history.ts:497, `new oc.gp_Pnt(0, 0, neutralZ)`).
OCCT whole-body draft drafts 2 of 4 side faces on a box (14211.0245 vs closed form 13966.7726).
OCCT ignores the draft when hollowing after it (OCCT 6873.6942 vs closed form 5038.4868 on the off-centre box; 11072.4258 vs 8600.6604 on 40x40x20); brep-rs refuses draft-then-hollow.
OCCT drops draft angles below its tolerance (0.001 degrees returns the undrafted 32000).
OCCT/brep-rs refuse a hollow with wall >= half the smallest side even when the open face leaves a cavity.

OCCT planar volumes carry quadrature error on regular prisms (measured up to 3.7e-9 against the closed form); brep-rs and truck equal the closed form to 3e-14. Planar comparisons with OCCT as the reference therefore use 1e-8.
